24262-antinous-a-poem.creator: Unknown
24262-antinous-a-poem.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. stealer Of his white body is forever cold. In vain shall kisses on that nippled point Covering his heart-beats' silent place implore His life again to ope his eyes and feel her Presence along his veins this fortress hold Of love. Now no caressing hands anoint With growing joy that body's lusting lore.

arxiv-2107-05209.creator: A. Türkan, G. Bozkır, K. Azizi

arxiv-2111-03013.title: Nyx-Net: Network Fuzzing with Incremental Snapshots
arxiv-2111-03013.creator: Sergej Schumilo 1 , Cornelius Aschermann 1 , Andrea Jemmett 2 , Ali Abbasi 1 and Thorsten Holz 1 1 Ruhr-Universität Bochum 2 Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
arxiv-2111-03013.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sergej Schumilo 1 , Cornelius Aschermann 1 , Andrea Jemmett 2 , Ali Abbasi 1 and Thorsten Holz 1 1 Ruhr-Universität Bochum 2 Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. Coverage-guided fuzz testing (“fuzzing”) has become mainstream and we have observed lots of progress in this research area recently. However, it is still challenging to efficiently test network services with existing coverage-guided fuzzing methods.

arxiv-2302-12189.title: HL Dataset: Visually-grounded Description of Scenes, Actions and Rationales
arxiv-2302-12189.creator: Michele Cafagna Kees van Deemter Albert Gatt
arxiv-2302-12189.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michele Cafagna Kees van Deemter Albert Gatt. Current captioning datasets focus on object-centric captions, describing the visible objects in the image, e.g. ”people eating food in a park”. Although these datasets are useful to evaluate the ability of Vision & Language models to recognize and describe visual content, they do not support controlled experiments involving model testing or fine-tuning, with more high-level captions, which humans find easy and natural to produce.

arxiv-2405-05255.title: Diffusion-HMC: Parameter Inference with Diffusion-model-driven Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
arxiv-2405-05255.creator: Nayantara Mudur, Carolina Cuesta-Lazaro, Douglas P. Finkbeiner
arxiv-2405-05255.description: Abstract Diffusion generative models have excelled at diverse image generation and reconstruction tasks across fields. A less explored avenue is their application to discriminative tasks involving regression or classification problems. The cornerstone of modern cosmology is the ability to generate predictions for observed astrophysical fields from theory and constrain physical models from observations using these predictions.

arxiv-2410-03523.title: A Probabilistic Perspective on Unlearning and Alignment for Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-03523.creator: Yan Scholten, Stephan Günnemann, Leo Schwinn
arxiv-2410-03523.description: Abstract Comprehensive evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) is an open research problem. Existing evaluations rely on deterministic point estimates generated via greedy decoding. However, we find that deterministic evaluations fail to capture the whole output distribution of a model, yielding inaccurate estimations of model capabilities.

arxiv-2503-17602.title: Multiport Support for Vortex OpenGPU Memory Hierarchy
arxiv-2503-17602.creator: Injae Shin, Blaise Tine
arxiv-2503-17602.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Injae Shin, Blaise Tine. Modern day applications have grown in size and require more computational power. The rise of machine learning and AI increased the need for parallel computation, which has increased the need for GPGPUs. With the increasing demand for computational power, GPGPUs’ SIMT architecture has solved this with an increase in the number of threads and the number of cores in a GPU, increasing the throughput of these processors to match the demand of the applications.

arxiv-2503-24316.title: Structure and Fragmentation Scale of a Massive Star-Forming Filament in NGC6334: High-Resolution Mid-Infrared Absorption Imaging with JWST Facilities: JWST(MIRI), APEX(ArTéMiS), Herschel (SPIRE and PACS) , Spitzer
arxiv-2503-24316.creator: Philippe André, Michael Mattern, Doris Arzoumanian, Yoshito Shimajiri, Annie Zavagno, Daisei Abe, Delphine Russeil
arxiv-2503-24316.description: Abstract Dense filaments are believed to be representative of the initial conditions of star formation in molecular clouds. We have used the MIRI instrument on JWST to image the massive filament NGC 6334M at d ∼ 1.3 d\sim 1.3 kpc with unprecedented resolution and dynamic range at 7.7 and 25.5 μ \mu m.

arxiv-2508-06030.title: Efficient Knowledge Probing of Large Language Models by Adapting Pre-trained Embeddings
arxiv-2508-06030.creator: Kartik Sharma, Yiqiao Jin, Rakshit Trivedi, Srijan Kumar
arxiv-2508-06030.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) acquire knowledge across diverse domains such as science, history, and geography encountered during generative pre-training. However, due to their stochasticity, it is difficult to predict what LLMs have acquired. Prior work has developed different ways to probe this knowledge by investigating the hidden representations, crafting specific task prompts, curating representative samples, and estimating their uncertainty.

arxiv-2512-01463.title: hls4ml: A Flexible, Open-Source Platform for Deep Learning Acceleration on Reconfigurable Hardware CCS: Hardware Hardware accelerators CCS: Hardware Reconfigurable logic applications CCS: Computing methodologies Machine learning
arxiv-2512-01463.creator: Jan-Frederik Schulte, Benjamin Ramhorst, Chang Sun, Jovan Mitrevski, Nicolò Ghielmetti, Enrico Lupi, Dimitrios Danopoulos, Vladimir Lončar, Javier Duarte, David Burnette, Lauri Laatu, Stylianos Tzelepis, Konstantinos Axiotis, Quentin Berthet, Haoyan Wang, Paul White, Suleyman Demirsoy, Marco Colombo
arxiv-2512-01463.description: Abstract . We present hls4ml , a free and open-source platform that translates machine learning (ML) models from modern deep learning frameworks into high-level synthesis (HLS) code that can be integrated into full designs for field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) or application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs).

arxiv-2512-09074.title: Modular Deep-Learning-Based Early Warning System for Deadly Heatwave Prediction
arxiv-2512-09074.creator: Shangqing Xu, Zhiyuan Zhao, Megha Sharma, José María Martín-Olalla, Alexander Rodríguez, Gregory A. Wellenius, B. Aditya Prakash
arxiv-2512-09074.description: Abstract Severe heatwaves in urban areas significantly threaten public health, calling for establishing early warning strategies. Despite predicting occurrence of heatwaves and attributing historical mortality, predicting an incoming deadly heatwave remains a challenge due to the difficulty in defining and estimating heat-related mortality.

pmc-11302163.title: Effect of hydrogen peroxide versus charcoal-based whitening mouthwashes on color, surface roughness, and color stability of enamel
pmc-11302163.creator: Mayada S Sultan
pmc-11302163.description: BackgroundPatients tend to favor the whitening mouthwashes as they are easily applied and affordable. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of hydrogen peroxide versus charcoal-based whitening mouthwashes on color, surface roughness, and color stability of enamel. In the current study, the whitening mouthwashes used have the ability to stop future stains due to their white seal technology.

pmc-11496556.title: Impact of distant metastasis on overall survival and cancer specific survival of elderly patients with differentiated thyroid cancer
pmc-11496556.creator: Shuqian Chen, Lizhen Xu, Shuyao Pan, Gang Chen
pmc-11496556.description: Distant metastases are common in most elderly patients, because elderly patients are diagnosed with advanced thyroid cancer due to delayed diagnosis. There is still few specific real-world data regarding prognosis in the elderly with differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC). The purpose of this study is to evaluate the prognostic factors and survival rate of elderly DTC patients with metastasis.

pmc-11565078.title: Establishing Medical Intelligence—Leveraging Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources to Improve Clinical Management: Retrospective Cohort and Clinical Implementation Study
pmc-11565078.creator: Alexander Brehmer, Christopher Martin Sauer, Jayson Salazar Rodríguez, Kelsey Herrmann, Moon Kim, Julius Keyl, Fin Hendrik Bahnsen, Benedikt Frank, Martin Köhrmann, Tienush Rassaf, Amir-Abbas Mahabadi, Boris Hadaschik, Christopher Darr, Ken Herrmann, Susanne Tan, Jan Buer, Thorsten Brenner, Hans Chr
pmc-11565078.description: BackgroundFHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) has been proposed to enable health data interoperability. So far, its applicability has been demonstrated for selected research projects with limited data.ObjectiveThis study aimed to design and implement a conceptual medical intelligence framework to leverage real-world care data for clinical decision-making.

This study examined the short and medium-term outcomes of 22,540 adult cardiac surgical patients requiring an IABP. Methods From 2009 to 2018, 1114 patients (4.

pmc-11680711.title: Clinical and Dermoscopic Evaluation of Patients With Topical Steroid Damaged Faces (TSDF)
pmc-11680711.creator: Arushi Goel, Aneet Mahendra, Sanjeev Gupta
pmc-11680711.description: BackgroundTopical steroid-dependent or damaged face (TSDF) is a common condition where the widespread availability of over-the-counter topical corticosteroid (TCS)-containing products leads to their misuse and addiction. Prolonged use of these steroids on the face can result in significant side effects. Early diagnosis and cessation of steroid use are important.

pmc-12512682.title: Impact of vaccination on SARS-CoV-2 infections and long COVID symptoms: a cross-sectional study in China
pmc-12512682.creator: Xiaolong Yan, Xin Zhao, Hao Wang, Yin Du, Li Liu, Jianhua Liu, Qi Wang, Sheng Wei
pmc-12512682.description: BackgroundFollowing the adjustment of the dynamic zero-COVID-19 strategy, China has witnessed a rapid increase in COVID-19 cases. However, the relationship between diverse vaccination statuses and the spectrum of symptom presentation, disease severity, and long-term post-COVID conditions remains to be fully understood.

pmc-12569338.title: Applications of artificial intelligence in diagnosis and treatment planning of orthodontics: a narrative review
pmc-12569338.creator: Sania Azizi, Sepehr Hatampoor, Shabnam Tahamtan
pmc-12569338.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) has recently gained significant interest in orthodontics due to its ability to enhance diagnostic accuracy, guide treatment planning, and improve therapeutic outcomes. This review aimed to explore the relevance and applications of AI across various aspects of orthodontics.

pmc-13090721.title: Efficient whole-cell biotransformation for gastrodin production via glycosyltransferase engineering and process optimization
pmc-13090721.creator: Xun Wang, Jiale Zhang, Tao Li, Fei Wang, Zhiguo Wang, Xun Li
pmc-13090721.description: Gastrodin is a naturally occurring phenolic glycoside derived from Gastrodia elata, which is widely used as an edible medicinal plant in functional foods and dietary supplements in East Asia. Owing to its antioxidant, neuroprotective, and metabolic regulatory activities, gastrodin has attracted increasing attention as a valuable plant-derived glycoside for food and nutraceutical applications.

pmc-13382402.title: Resolution of anhedonia-like symptoms in patients treated for obesity with tirzepatide: A three-case series
pmc-13382402.creator: Spencer Nadolsky, Summer Kessel, Zachary A. Krumm, Grant M. Tinsley
pmc-13382402.description: IntroductionGlucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP1RAs) have demonstrated substantial efficacy for obesity and metabolic disease treatment, with emerging evidence suggesting effects on reward-processing pathways and motivated behaviors. Although reductions in food craving and addictive behaviors may be beneficial, some patients anecdotally report diminished motivation and anhedonia-like symptoms during high-dose therapy.
